## Your frequently asked questions.

 While we’ve tried to make this tool as easy to use as possible, it’s okay to have questions. If you don’t find your answers here, contact our customer support. 

###### What’s Kickresume’s pricing?

Kickresume offers two account options: Free and Premium. With a free account, you can create and download unlimited resumes using the free customization options.Premium is $24/month, but you can save by choosing a quarterly plan at $18/month—or get the best value with a yearly plan at just $8/month.

###### Is Online AI Career Coach free to use?

Creating a Kickresume account is completely free, and you’ll get access to most of our AI tools, resume and cover letter builders, and writers (with some limits on customization). If you’d like to unlock everything, including our Online Career Coach, you’ll need a Premium account. The good news? Students and teachers can get Premium for free with a valid ISIC, ITIC, or UNiDAYS verification.

###### How can I access Kickresume’s Online AI Career Coach?
